newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SELECTORS KEEP FAITH WITH VICTORIOUS S. AFRICAN SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SELECTORS KEEP FAITH WITH VICTORIOUS S. AFRICAN SQUAD.

text.p: South African selectors on Monday kept faith with the team which won the Kenyan four nations tournament in Nairobi at the weekend when they announced their squad to tour India later this month.

The entire 14-man squad, who returned to Johannesburg from Kenya on Monday, were named by convener of selectors Peter Pollock for the first part of the two-month tour of India which starts on October 13.

Pollock said the 14 players had been selected for the initial limited-overs triangular series with hosts India and Australia between October 17 and November 7 but that possible changes could then be made for the three three-day matches and a three-test series aginst India which follow.

Pollock said Shaun Pollock (ankle injury), Jacques Kallis (back strain), Craig Matthews (tendon strain) and Paul Adams (groin strain) were in the frame for possible selection for the latter part of the tour once they recovered from injury.

South African squad: Hansie Cronje (captain), Gary Kirsten (vice-captain), Andrew Hudson, Daryll Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Brian McMillan, Derek Crookes, Dave Richardson, Lance Klusener, Pat Symcox, Fanie de Villiers, Allan Donald, Herschelle Gibbs, Nicy Boje.
